text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after El Condor Pasa has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whaaam!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It's finally time! After all this
waiting, it's
finally here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've finally finished my eternal
fight,
we're going to the golden city of
El Dorado!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Did you forget about the
promise
you made back when we won
the raffle?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! A hot spring vacation coupon?!
Whoa...
this is a huge win!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's go once everything's
calmed down
after the Twinkle Series
and we have some time
on our hands!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Which would be right now! If we let this
chance
pass us by, when else could we
possibly go?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I wanna give you a nice, relaxing hot
spring
break!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe the real reason is a liiiittle
different.
I just really, really wanna hang
out with you,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Huh? Was that really your reason f...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's not a little different, it's completely different. But still, a promise is a promise.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, it's time to go soak

ourselves in the golden waters of the hot
springs!
Let's find the golden monkey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was sure this would turn out to be a
hectic trip
without a moment to rest, but
actually...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, Trainer! This is really bad...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's me! And I messed up big time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I went into the hot spring with my mask
on, and
now it's soaked!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can put it back on
until it
dries...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So I came to your room so we could
hang out
until then! With my real face!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well... that's gonna be a no from me!
choice_data_list: Why not stay in your own room?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I came on this trip to talk to you, after
all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm a little embarrassed to
be here as
just plain unmasked El, I still
mean to make good
on that plan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I end up spending time
with a
maskless El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is a little strange. At first I was a
little
anxious, but now...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I feel pretty comfortable. Almost like
I'm... home.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Do you want some tea, Trainer? Also,
can you
gimme... I mean, can I have one
of those candies?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, this is bad! I worked hard on my
character
development...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but...
choice_data_list: You don't have to push yourself, y...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's true... And I took off my mask
too...
choice_data_list: You came all the way out here to r...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Maybe I don't need to be so tense. Um...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with my mama and papa, I'm
not always
so loud...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I settle down and let them
baby me a
little. Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is it okay if I hang out with you like
that

sometimes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Just like when I was little!
choice_data_list: Of course, let's talk all you want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El and I speak for a long time, much
more freely
and easily than usual.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! This has been so much fun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ojalá pudiera ser siempre así. ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: N-nothing! Anyway...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I think my mask should be done drying
for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue to talk for hours and lose
track of time. The food is delicious, and
her unmasked
smiling face seems more
innocent than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that El Condor Pasa and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
